description: Elaborate the system and evaluate it: every requirement with its verdict (satisfied, violated, indeterminate), value, limit and margin; constraint verdicts; analysis findings (budgets, clashes, interfaces, safety); and every attribute value with its source (stated, computed, default). Use it to answer 'does the design meet its requirements' or 'what is the total mass'.

root.description: The top level part usage to elaborate (default: the last one, the configured system).

selection.description: Variant choices by instance path, e.g. {"commuter.battery": "longRange"}.

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

name: evaluate
title: Evaluate requirements and values
